title: Iteration of the Round Machine
statement: Let $k,n,t$ be natural numbers, let $x$ be a Boolean input word, and let $M$ be a machine with $k$ Boolean work tapes and $n+1$ states. Suppose $c$ remains in a live state through time $t$. For every augmented configuration $d$ at the round machine's entry state that represents $c$ and $M$'s transition rule, there is a time $T$ with $t\le T\le t\,50(L+1)$, where $L$ is the encoded transition table length, such that the round machine is again at its entry state and represents $M$'s configuration at time $t$. Through time $T$, its output remains unchanged and it never reaches the halt state. Every original work-tape cell visited by the round machine's corresponding head through time $T$ is visited by the corresponding head of $M$ through time $t$; every cell visited by either auxiliary head lies in the integer interval $[-50(L+1),50(L+1)]$.
